entries.title: Agent Runtime update: run-agent-step

ai.title: Agent runtime preserves history context after failed turns and size
ai.summary: The agent runtime now explicitly marks failed or refused turns in the root agent's message history by appending `TURN_FAILED_NOTE` or `USER_PROMPT_REFUSED_NOTE`, preventing the failed prompt from joining the next live request verbatim during compaction. The `assertUserContentSize` guard in `context-size-guard.ts` now throws `UserContentTooLargeError` carrying the refused `Message[]` array so the runtime can remove them from history, since a refused message would otherwise be re-sent on the next turn. The constant `MAX_USER_CONTENT_TOKENS` (128_000) is now defined in `context-size-guard.ts` and used by the guard to cap new user content unless the model's context budget is smaller.
ai.evidence: In `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`, the catch block in `loopAgentSteps` now checks for `UserContentTooLargeError` to filter refused messages from history and appends `TURN_FAILED_NOTE` or `USER_PROMPT_REFUSED_NOTE`. In `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/context-size-guard.ts`, `assertUserContentSize` now throws the new `UserContentTooLargeError` carrying the refused `Message[]` instead of a generic `Error`.

eli5.text: When a coding session ends in error or the assistant rejects a message as too large, the system now explicitly labels that moment in the conversation history and removes the oversized message. This prevents the failed content from being accidentally resent during the next step of the same task. For users, this is an internal reliability fix that helps the assistant recover more cleanly from errors; no new settings or actions are required.
